projects.title: FoodHub — Multi-Vendor Food Delivery & Marketplace Platform
projects.description:
FoodHub is a full-stack multi-vendor food delivery platform designed to connect customers, food vendors, and delivery partners through a single web application. The platform allows customers to discover food, browse vendors and categories, add products to their cart, place orders, make online payments, track deliveries, and manage their profiles.

Vendors have dedicated dashboards where they can manage their restaurants, food categories and menu items, update product availability, receive and process orders, and track order status. Delivery partners can view assigned deliveries, update delivery status, and share their current location for customer tracking.

The platform also includes JWT-based API authentication, role-based access control, OTP-based verification, shopping cart and order management, Razorpay payment integration, delivery assignment, Google Maps integration, and an administrative interface.
projects.tech_stack: Django, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Redis, Celery, Razorpay, Google Maps API, Nginx, Gunicorn, GitHub Actions, Linode
